description: This file contains controller logic for executing differential analysis, including orchestrating external scripts, handling CSV files, and managing manifest files within a version control project. It also defines functions for setting up the working environment, running Python scripts, and persisting analyzed diff data.

methods.name: ExecuteDifferentials
methods.description: Main function to execute differential analysis for all targets configured in the application, managing setup, execution, and output transfer.

methods.name: defineCommonManifest
methods.description: Initializes a common manifest by executing a 'repo init' command and parsing the resulting XML manifest file.

methods.name: createWorkingPath
methods.description: Creates the specified directory path with full permissions.

methods.name: printFunctionDuration
methods.description: Prints the execution duration of a specified function.

methods.name: clearOutputDirectory
methods.description: Removes all contents of the output directory to prepare for new outputs.

methods.name: setupCommand
methods.description: Prepares an execution command for a Python script, attaching relevant manifest URLs and branches.

methods.name: runPyScript
methods.description: Runs the differential Python script, monitors output files, and returns new CSV filenames.

methods.name: diffTarget
methods.description: Executes the differential analysis Python script with logging and error handling.

methods.name: TransferScriptOutputToDownstream
methods.description: Reads CSV output files, applies mutations, and persists the diff data downstream.

methods.name: loadTargetManifests
methods.description: Loads upstream and downstream manifest files for a target project.

methods.name: readCSVFiles
methods.description: Converts project and commit CSV files into entity slices.

methods.name: toDiffRows
methods.description: Converts a list of generic entities into a slice of DiffRow objects.

methods.name: CSVFileToCommitRows
methods.description: Converts a CSV file into CommitRow entities.

methods.name: toCommitRows
methods.description: Converts a list of interfaces into CommitRow objects.

methods.name: persistDiffRowsDownstream
methods.description: Persists diff rows into the project repository, handling errors properly.
